description: Flag whether a client request is in scope, out of scope, or unclear, estimate a price, and draft a polite change-order reply. Not legal advice. Reuses ChangeOrder's deterministic keyword classifier (not an LLM).

client.description: Client name for the greeting. Optional.

hours.description: Estimated hours for the extra work. Defaults to 4.

rush.description: If true, apply a 50% rush surcharge.

scope.description: The signed scope of work, one item per line or semicolon-separated.

name: generate_change_order
title: Generate a change order
